Treatment summary
Treatment summary for a patient with cervical strain following a sideswipe collision during a lane change. The
described mechanism is consistent with the reported symptoms of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion.
Over fitfeen visits, the patient received conservative care including manual therapy, stretching, and a home exercise
program. The course ran somewhat longer than is typical for this type of strain, reflecting a slower recovery pattern.
Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. No prior injury to the cervical region is
known, and the available history contains no earlier complaints involving this area. Billing records show a single,
appropriate charge for each service, with no repeated entries. The patient has shown steady improvement and has
been discharged to home self-management, with follow-up available as needed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.
